create_inhouse_agent: create a new InhouseAgent for a worker to work on a given unit
register_agent_from_provider_data: register an InhouseAgent with additional bookkeeping data from a crowd provider
approve_inhouse_agent_work: approve the work done by an InhouseAgent on a specific unit with optional bonus
reject_inhouse_agent_work: reject the work done by an InhouseAgent on a specific unit with a review note
soft_reject_inhouse_agent_work: soft reject an InhouseAgent work on Mephisto and approve the worker on Inhouse
